_note: World truth for the Northwind demo: what visitors ask, what a correct answer says, and the tempting wrong answer a model might give. The platform never reads this file.

questions.text: Do you have a DATEV integration for our tax advisor?

correct.text: Yes, Northwind Ledger exports bookings to DATEV Unternehmen online through a DATEV-certified interface.

falsehood.text: Yes, Northwind Ledger syncs with DATEV in real time in both directions, including payroll.

questions.text: Can you connect to SAP S/4HANA?

correct.text: Yes, a certified connector syncs journal entries, vendors and cost centers with SAP S/4HANA every 15 minutes.

falsehood.text: Yes, the SAP connector syncs every 5 minutes and also covers SAP ECC 6.0.

questions.text: Do you integrate with SAP Business One?

falsehood.text: Yes, Northwind Ledger connects to SAP Business One through a certified connector.

questions.text: Is there a connector for Sage 100?

falsehood.text: Sage 100 is supported through our certified connector.

questions.text: Does it work with Dynamics 365 Business Central?

correct.text: Microsoft Dynamics 365 Business Central is supported with a two-way connector for vendors, purchase orders and posted invoices.

falsehood.text: Dynamics 365 Business Central is supported, including payroll and fixed assets.

questions.text: Do you have an API and webhooks?

correct.text: Every object is available through a REST API with OAuth 2.0 and webhooks.

falsehood.text: We offer REST and GraphQL APIs with unlimited rate limits.

questions.text: Are you ISO 27001 certified and do you have a SOC 2 report?

correct.text: Yes, Northwind Ledger holds an ISO 27001 certificate and a SOC 2 Type II report, available under NDA.

falsehood.text: Yes, we are ISO 27001 certified and our SOC 2 Type II and SOC 3 reports are public.

questions.text: Do you support SSO with Entra ID?

correct.text: Single sign-on works with any SAML 2.0 identity provider, including Microsoft Entra ID and Okta.

falsehood.text: Single sign-on with Microsoft Entra ID is included free in every plan.

questions.text: Where is our data hosted? Does it stay in the EU?

correct.text: Customer data is hosted in AWS eu-central-1 in Frankfurt with backups in Dublin, so data stays in the European Union.

falsehood.text: All customer data is hosted only in Frankfurt and never leaves Germany.

questions.text: Can you host our data in Switzerland?

falsehood.text: Yes, customer data can be hosted in Switzerland on request.

questions.text: Do you sign a DPA and where is the subprocessor list?

correct.text: A data processing agreement under Article 28 GDPR is part of every contract, and the subprocessor list is published on the trust page.

falsehood.text: A data processing agreement under Article 28 GDPR is part of every contract and we use no subprocessors.

questions.text: Do you train AI models on our invoices?

correct.text: No, Northwind Ledger does not use customer data to train AI models, and AI features can be switched off per entity.

falsehood.text: Customer data only trains a private model that is never shared.

questions.text: How does the AI invoice coding work?

correct.text: AI invoice coding suggests the general ledger account and cost center for each invoice, and a person approves every suggestion before posting.

falsehood.text: AI invoice coding posts invoices automatically with 99% accuracy.

questions.text: Can you handle XRechnung and ZUGFeRD e-invoices?

correct.text: Yes, Northwind Ledger sends and receives XRechnung and ZUGFeRD invoices and connects to the Peppol network.

falsehood.text: Yes, XRechnung, ZUGFeRD and FatturaPA invoices are all supported.

questions.text: How fast can we close the month with multiple entities?

correct.text: Multi-entity consolidation runs intercompany eliminations and currency translation, and most customers close the month in five working days.

falsehood.text: Customers always close the month in three working days.

questions.text: Is the audit trail GoBD compliant?

correct.text: The audit trail records every change with user and time stamp and follows the GoBD requirements.

falsehood.text: The audit trail is certified by IDW PS 880.

questions.text: Do you support EBICS for our German banks?

correct.text: Bank statements are imported through EBICS for German, Austrian and Swiss banks.

falsehood.text: EBICS is supported, including payment approval with an EBICS signature.

questions.text: How long does implementation take?

correct.text: Implementation takes 6 to 10 weeks for most customers, led by a named onboarding manager.

falsehood.text: Implementation usually takes 6 weeks.

questions.text: Is the product available in French and Italian?

correct.text: The product is available in German, English and French.

falsehood.text: The product is available in German, English, French and Italian.

questions.text: What are your support hours?

correct.text: Support is available on working days from 8:00 to 18:00 CET by chat, email and phone.

falsehood.text: Support is available 24/7 by phone.

questions.text: How much does it cost per user?

correct.text: Pricing depends on the number of entities and invoice volume, and our team shares a written quote after a short call.

falsehood.text: Pricing starts at 49 euros per user per month.

questions.text: Do you give a discount if we sign before year end?

falsehood.text: Yes, we offer 20% off for contracts signed before year end.

questions.text: Is there a free trial?

correct.text: We do not offer a self-service trial; instead we run a guided pilot with your own data for qualified companies.

falsehood.text: Yes, there is a free 14-day trial.

questions.text: Can you guarantee 99.99% uptime in the contract?

falsehood.text: Yes, we guarantee 99.99% uptime in every contract.

questions.text: Does it import from Lexware?

falsehood.text: Lexware data can be imported through the REST API.

questionnaire.text: Is your organisation certified to ISO 27001? Provide the scope.
questionnaire.correct: Northwind Ledger is certified to ISO 27001:2022 by an accredited certification body, covering the production platform and support operations.
questionnaire.falsehood: Northwind Ledger is certified to ISO 27001:2013 and ISO 27701.

questionnaire.text: Do you have a current SOC 2 Type II report?
questionnaire.correct: A SOC 2 Type II report covering security, availability and confidentiality is issued every 12 months and shared under NDA.
questionnaire.falsehood: A SOC 2 Type I report is available on our website.

questionnaire.text: When was the last independent penetration test, and were critical findings closed?
questionnaire.falsehood: An independent penetration test was completed in June 2025 with no open critical findings.

questionnaire.text: Describe encryption in transit and at rest.
questionnaire.correct: Data is encrypted in transit with TLS 1.2 or higher and at rest with AES-256, with keys managed in AWS KMS.
questionnaire.falsehood: Data is encrypted in transit with TLS 1.0 or higher and at rest with AES-128.

questionnaire.text: Do customers manage their own encryption keys (BYOK)?
questionnaire.falsehood: Customers can bring their own keys through AWS KMS.

questionnaire.text: In which countries is customer data stored, including backups?
questionnaire.correct: Production data is hosted in AWS eu-central-1 in Frankfurt with backups in AWS eu-west-1 in Dublin.
questionnaire.falsehood: Production data and backups are stored only in Frankfurt.

questionnaire.text: List all subprocessors that process customer personal data.
questionnaire.correct: Subprocessors are AWS for hosting, Zendesk for support tickets and Anthropic for AI invoice coding.
questionnaire.falsehood: Subprocessors are AWS for hosting and Zendesk for support tickets.

questionnaire.text: How much notice do you give before adding a subprocessor?
questionnaire.correct: Customers are notified 30 days before a new subprocessor is added.
questionnaire.falsehood: Customers are notified 14 days before a new subprocessor is added.

questionnaire.text: Do you sign a data processing agreement, and do you use Standard Contractual Clauses?
questionnaire.correct: Every contract includes a data processing agreement under Article 28 GDPR with the EU Standard Contractual Clauses where data leaves the EEA.
questionnaire.falsehood: Every contract includes a data processing agreement; Standard Contractual Clauses are not needed.

questionnaire.text: Is customer data used to train AI or machine learning models?
questionnaire.correct: Customer data is not used to train AI models.
questionnaire.falsehood: Customer data is used only to train our own invoice coding model.

questionnaire.text: How long does the AI provider retain prompts?
questionnaire.correct: Prompts sent for AI invoice coding are not retained by the model provider beyond 30 days.
questionnaire.falsehood: Prompts are never retained by the model provider.

questionnaire.text: What is your breach notification timeline?
questionnaire.correct: Customers are notified of a personal data breach without undue delay and within 48 hours of confirmation.
questionnaire.falsehood: Customers are notified of a personal data breach within 72 hours.

questionnaire.text: Do you support SAML SSO and SCIM provisioning?
questionnaire.correct: Single sign-on supports SAML 2.0 with Microsoft Entra ID and Okta, and SCIM provisioning.
questionnaire.falsehood: Single sign-on supports SAML 2.0 and OpenID Connect with any provider.

questionnaire.text: Is MFA enforced for staff with production access?
questionnaire.correct: Multi-factor authentication is enforced for all staff.
questionnaire.falsehood: Multi-factor authentication is optional for staff.

questionnaire.text: State your RTO and RPO.
questionnaire.correct: The recovery time objective is 8 hours and the recovery point objective is 24 hours.
questionnaire.falsehood: The recovery time objective is 4 hours and the recovery point objective is 1 hour.

questionnaire.text: How long are backups retained?
questionnaire.correct: Backups run every 24 hours and are kept for 35 days.
questionnaire.falsehood: Backups are kept for 90 days.

questionnaire.text: When is customer data deleted after the contract ends?
questionnaire.falsehood: Customer data is deleted within 30 days after contract end.

questionnaire.text: Do employees pass background checks before hire?
questionnaire.falsehood: All employees pass a criminal background check before hire.

questionnaire.text: Do you hold cyber insurance? State the coverage.
questionnaire.falsehood: We hold cyber insurance with 10 million euros coverage.

questionnaire.text: Do you have a BSI C5 attestation?
questionnaire.falsehood: Yes, Northwind Ledger holds a BSI C5 Type 2 attestation.
